name: alita-vscode
description: A VS Code native AI coding agent powered by any OpenAI-compatible API gateway. Agent mode with file read/edit, terminal, and search tools.

chatParticipants.name: alita
chatParticipants.description: AI coding agent with file, terminal, and search tools.

languageModelTools.name: alita_readFiles
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read file contents from the workspace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the content of one or more files. Use this when you need to examine code or documentation files in the workspace.

languageModelTools.name: alita_editFile
languageModelTools.userDescription: Edit a file in the workspace using SEARCH/REPLACE
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Apply SEARCH/REPLACE edits to files. Use SEARCH/REPLACE blocks to specify changes.

languageModelTools.name: alita_terminal
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run a shell command in the terminal
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Execute shell commands. Use for builds, tests, git operations.

languageModelTools.name: alita_searchFiles
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search for files or content in the workspace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search workspace files by content or filename pattern.

target.description: Search inside content or by filename

alita.gatewayUrl.description: The URL of the OpenAI-compatible API gateway. Also configurable via ALITA_GATEWAY_URL env var.

alita.apiKey.description: API key for the gateway. Also configurable via ALITA_API_KEY env var. Leave empty if your gateway doesn't require authentication.
